paras: Here is why Moton Suspension is trusted by podium-winning drivers around the world:

All Moton systems utilize a rugged non-inverted monotube design, include matched springs, and are fully rebuildable. The primary differences lie in the damping adjustability and the addition of remote reservoirs.
